verdict.rationale: Ramp documents an official, account-scoped remote MCP server at mcp.ramp.com/mcp for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other MCP clients. It has admin role and user restrictions, demo and multi-business endpoints, and example read/action prompts, plus separate Developer and Data MCP servers. Live probes confirm an OAuth-protected MCP endpoint with granular scopes and an unauthenticated docs MCP server responding to initialize. Missing for 10: independent user-reported hands-on corroboration of agent workflows, and bill approvals, which the docs say aren't yet available via MCP.
